verdict.rationale: Gram documents an in-dashboard agent harness for testing MCP servers before connecting a real client. You pick a server, authenticate, chat with a model that calls the tools, and inspect the logs, so the core of the story is delivered in the browser. However, tools are exercised indirectly through model chat, and only one thin doc line supports this. missing for 10: direct manual tool invocation with user-supplied arguments (inspector-style), detailed playground documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can exercise an MCP server's tools from a browser-based inspector or playground before integrating it
